description: This file defines an interface 'LocalDispatcherFactory' in the org.apache.ofbiz.service package. It declares a method for creating or retrieving a 'LocalDispatcher' instance based on a name and a delegator, serving as a factory contract for such objects within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LocalDispatcherFactory
classes.description: An interface serving as a factory for creating or retrieving 'LocalDispatcher' instances. Implementations of this interface register themselves within the OFBiz component configuration to enable dynamic dispatching.

methods.name: createLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a 'LocalDispatcher' instance associated with the given 'name' and 'delegator'. If an appropriate dispatcher already exists, it returns that instead of creating a new one.
